***WEB REPORT*** ON 04/26/13 AT 1529 HOURS, THE BC TRAIN DISPATCHER REPORTED TRAIN U78819 DERAILED APPROXIMATELY SEVEN OR EIGHT COAL CARS AT MP CFQ 7.4 ON THE RF&P SUBDIVISION. THIS WAS LOCATED NEAR THE CAISSON ROAD CROSSING IN FREDERICKSBURG, VA. FOUR CARS ARE OVERTURNED; NO WATER WAYS ARE AFFECTED. STAFFORD COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE WAS NOTIFIED. UPDATE: S.R. AT 1614 HOURS, A MECHANICAL DEPARTMENT REPRESENTATIVE ADVISED TWO CARS ON THEIR SIDE, TWO WERE LEANING, AND FOUR WERE UP-RIGHT (NO CAR NUMBERS WERE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME). CRANEMASTERS WERE NOTIFIED AND RESPONDING OUT OF TINYTOWN AND HULCHER WAS NOTIFIED AND RESPONDING FROM GETTYSBURG. NO ETAS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. UPDATE: AT 1737 HOURS, A S/A ADVISED HE WAS RESPONDING AND SHOULD ARRIVE ON SCENE AT APRROXIMATELY 1900 HOURS. UPDATE: AT 1813 HOURS, AN SSA ADVISED HE WAS ON SCENE. THE ROAD WAY IS CLEAR. WAITING FOR CRANES TO ARRIVE ON SCENE. UPDATE: AT 1952 HOURS, THE MECHANICAL DESK REPORTED CARS CSXT 390190, 392297, 390746, 390714, 392105, 393721, 390680 AND 390493 WERE THE CARS THAT DERAILED. UPDATE: ON 04/27/13 AT 0044 HOURS, THE MECHANICAL DESK REPORTED ESTIMATED DAMAGE AT $86,620. UPDATE: ON 4/27/13 AT 0425 HOURS, TOTAL COST IS 175,800 DOLLARS
